properties.name: smartscity.id.epoch
properties.description: Whole-second epoch, immutable for an ID namespace; changing it requires a namespace migration.

properties.name: smartscity.id.bits.timestamp
properties.description: Timestamp width in seconds. Supply all three widths together or use profile defaults.

properties.name: smartscity.id.bits.worker
properties.description: Worker width. Supply all three widths together; changing widths requires namespace migration.

properties.name: smartscity.id.bits.sequence
properties.description: Sequence width. Total width must not exceed 63 bits (53 for javascript).
